
---
title: "03- Alpha Diversity: Intra-Group Variability (Longitudinal)"
subtitle: "Responding to reviewer: DTG shows more consistent increases than DRV/r"
---


## Define the input and output paths

```{r}
# input
tse_file <- here::here("data", "processed", "tse_alpha.rds")

# output
out_dir <- here::here("data", "03_alpha_diversity_intra_var")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# confounders 
confounders <- c(
  "treatment",
  "time_point",
  "gender",
  "risk_group",
  "record_id",
  "age"
)

# formula
mod_formula <- glue::glue(
  "ly ~ treatment * time_point + gender + scale(age, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) + risk_group + (1|record_id)"
)

metrics <- c(
  "shannon_diversity", "gini_dominance","observed_richness"
)
```

## Set-up

```{r}
# load libraries
library(magrittr)
library(patchwork)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidySingleCellExperiment))
source(here::here("R", "utils.R"))

# variables for correlation
all_markers_abb <- c("CD4", "CD8", "CD4_CD38_DR", "CD8_CD38_DR", "CRP", "IL6", "TNFa", "sCD14", "BMI")

all_markers_long <- c("CD4+ T cells", "CD8+ T cells", "CD4+ CD38+ HLA-DR+ T cells", "CD8+ CD38+ HLA-DR+ T cells", "CRP", "IL-6", "TNF-a", "sCD14", "BMI")
```

## Load TSE Object and Transform

```{r}
tse <- 
  readr::read_rds(tse_file) %>% 
  mia::transformAssay(method = "relab") %>% 
  mia::transformAssay(method = "clr", pseudocount = 1) %>% 
  mia::transformAssay(method = "log10", pseudocount = 1)

tse
```

## Subject-level slopes (primary analysis)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
baseline_tp <- "0"
alpha_vars <- unique(c(
  metrics,
  intersect("gene_richness", colnames(colData(tse)))
))

delta_long <-
  colData(tse) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(confounders, alpha_vars))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.character), as.factor),
    tp_num = as.numeric(as.character(time_point))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(record_id, tp_num) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
    dplyr::all_of(alpha_vars),
    ~ log2(.x + 1e-6),
    .names = "ly_{.col}"
  )) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(record_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
    dplyr::starts_with("ly_"),
    ~ .x - .x[which(time_point == baseline_tp)[1]],
    .names = "d_{.col}"
  )) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

slope_df <-
  delta_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    dplyr::starts_with("d_ly_"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "delta"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metric = gsub("^d_ly_", "", metric)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(delta)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(metric, treatment, record_id) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(tp_num) >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(
    ~ {
      fit <- lm(delta ~ tp_num, data = .x)
      tibble::tibble(slope = coef(fit)[["tp_num"]])
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

slope_var_summary <-
  slope_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(metric, treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = n(),
    sd = sd(slope),
    mad = mad(slope, constant = 1.4826),
    iqr = IQR(slope),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

readr::write_csv(
  slope_var_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "intragroup_slope_variability.csv")
)

slope_var_summary
```

### Variance Comparison

```{r}
slope_tests <-
  slope_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(
    ~ {
      df <- .x
      bf <- rstatix::levene_test(
        slope ~ treatment,
        data = df,
        center = "median"
      )
      fl <- broom::tidy(stats::fligner.test(slope ~ treatment, data = df))
      tibble(
        test = c("Brown-Forsythe", "Fligner-Killeen"),
        statistic = c(bf$statistic, fl$statistic),
        p = c(bf$p, fl$p.value)
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(test) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

readr::write_csv(
  slope_tests,
  file.path(out_dir, "intragroup_slope_var_tests.csv")
)

slope_tests
```

### Variance ratio (DTG / DRV/r)

```{r}
set.seed(123)
vr_boot_slopes <-
  slope_df %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ {
      d <- .x
      s1 <- d %>% filter(treatment == "DTG") %>% pull(slope)
      s0 <- d %>% filter(treatment == "DRV/r") %>% pull(slope)
      lnVR <- log(var(s1) / var(s0))
      B <- 5000
      bt <- replicate(
        B,
        log(var(sample(s1, replace = TRUE)) / var(sample(s0, replace = TRUE)))
      )
      tibble(
        VR = exp(lnVR),
        ci_low = exp(quantile(bt, .025, na.rm = TRUE)),
        ci_high = exp(quantile(bt, .975, na.rm = TRUE))
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

readr::write_csv(
  vr_boot_slopes,
  file.path(out_dir, "slope_variance_ratio_bootstrap.csv")
)

vr_boot_slopes
```

### Plots

```{r}
p_slope_sd <-
  slope_var_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = stringr::str_replace_all(metric, "_", " ") %>% stringr::str_to_title()
  ) %>%
  tidyplots::tidyplot(
    x = metric,
    y = sd,
    colour = treatment,
    group = treatment
  ) %>%
  tidyplots::add_data_points(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 2.5
  ) %>%
  tidyplots::add_line() %>%
  tidyplots::adjust_y_axis_title("SD of slope (Δ per visit)") %>%
  tidyplots::adjust_legend_title("Treatment") %>% 
  tidyplots::adjust_size(width = 75, height = 75) %>% 
  tidyplots::adjust_x_axis(rotate_labels = TRUE) %>% 
  tidyplots::adjust_font(fontsize = 10)

tidyplots::save_plot(
  p_slope_sd,
  here::here(out_dir, "slope_sd_by_arm.pdf"),
  view_plot = FALSE
)

p_slope_sd
```

```{r}
p_vr_slopes <-
  vr_boot_slopes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = stringr::str_replace_all(metric, "_", " ") %>% stringr::str_to_title()
  ) %>%
  tidyplots::tidyplot(x = metric, y = VR) %>%
  tidyplots::add(geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high))) %>%
  tidyplots::add_reference_lines(y = 1) %>%
  tidyplots::adjust_colors(new_colors = "black") %>% 
  tidyplots::adjust_y_axis_title("Variance ratio (DTG / DRV/r)") %>% 
  tidyplots::adjust_size(width = 75, height = 75) %>% 
  tidyplots::adjust_x_axis(rotate_labels = TRUE) %>% 
  tidyplots::adjust_font(fontsize = 10)

tidyplots::save_plot(
  p_vr_slopes,
  here::here(out_dir, "slope_variance_ratio_ci.pdf"),
  view_plot = FALSE
)
p_vr_slopes
```
